exploratoryTitle: Exploratory analysis mode (§72): continued after researcher confirmation despite major data or methodological issues

samplingBody: This analysis used outcome-stratified sampled data ({{original}} → {{sampled}} rows, seed=42). The metrics below use the sampled dataset and should be reported accordingly.

iterate.title: Iterative Q&A
iterate.description: For example: “What if this column were a covariate?” or “Rerun without this column.” Answers use the real metrics from this run; executable suggestions include a structured rerun plan.
